name: Aqshmar
description: Aqshmar™ is the digital expression of a handcrafted clothing brand built by three sisters in Pakistan. Crafted with React, TypeScript & Framer Motion, this site blends modern web elegance with timeless embroidery, storytelling, and soul.

paragraphs: Aqshmar is a digitally handcrafted platform built to showcase a premium collection of hand-embroidered t-shirts made by three sisters preserving Pakistan’s rich cultural legacy. This is not just a web project — it’s a heartfelt experience woven with code and creativity.
🧵 Crafted by Maryam, Aqsa & Ayesha 💻 Developed by: Abdulrehman Gulfaraz 🌐 Live Site: Visit Aqshmar on Netlify 📸 Instagram: @aqshmar 📧 Contact: aqshmar.pk@gmail.com
“Every thread carries the wisdom of generations, every stitch tells a story of love.”
features: 🌸 Hero Section with emotional branding and tagline
🧶 Our Story — showcasing the journey of three sisters
✨ Craftsmanship Steps: Pattern Discovery → Color Curation → Stitching Ritual
🧵 Collection Gallery with products, color options, and pricing
🛒 Cart Store Logic using Zustand (for real store scalability)
